title: lidarmetricpy: forest-structure metrics from LiDAR at landscape scale

creators.name: Doi, Hideyuki
creators.affiliation: Graduate School of Informatics, Kyoto University

description: GPU/CPU Python package that computes forest-structure metrics per grid cell from airborne LiDAR point clouds: all 111 outputs of lidRmetrics::metrics_set3, the tree summaries of lidR's segmentation workflow and metrics of leafR, PyForestScan, forestr, ForestGapR and canopyLazR, each equal to the original package.
